tricks.name: Bunny Hop
tricks.description: Pull up the bars and jump the deck over the obstacle in one clean motion.

tricks.name: Ollie
tricks.description: Compress, hop, and pull the bars to lift both wheels and clear the obstacle.

tricks.name: Kickout
tricks.description: Kick the deck out to one side mid-air and snap it back before landing.

tricks.name: X-Up
tricks.description: Rotate the bars across each other into the X position and pull them back on landing.

tricks.name: Barspin
tricks.description: Spin the bars a full 360 and catch them cleanly before the landing.

tricks.name: No Footer
tricks.description: Release both feet off the deck mid-air and bring them back for the landing.

tricks.name: One Footer
tricks.description: Kick one foot off the deck mid-air and step back on without losing the line.

tricks.name: Manual
tricks.description: Balance on the rear wheel and ride the manual as long as possible without touching down.

tricks.name: Nose Manual
tricks.description: Balance on the front wheel with the deck tilted up and ride it out clean.

tricks.name: Nose Pivot
tricks.description: Spin the back end around the front wheel in a tight, controlled pivot.
Hop and rotate a half turn, landing square and rolling away forward.

tricks.name: Fakie 180
tricks.description: Spin 180 out of fakie and roll away forward in one smooth motion.

tricks.name: Footplant
tricks.description: Plant one foot on the obstacle mid-hop and push off back onto the deck.

tricks.name: Bar Hop
tricks.description: Hop the scooter over the bar or curb and land with both wheels square.

tricks.name: 50-50 Grind
tricks.description: Hop onto the obstacle, lock both pegs, and ride the grind to the end.

tricks.name: Double Peg Grind
tricks.description: Lock both pegs on the rail and slide the full length with the deck level.

tricks.name: Boardslide
tricks.description: Slide the deck flat across the obstacle with the pegs on either side of the edge.

tricks.name: Noseslide
tricks.description: Lock the front peg and slide the front of the deck down the full ledge.

tricks.name: Tailslide
tricks.description: Lock the back peg and slide the tail of the deck cleanly to the exit.

tricks.name: Feeble Grind
tricks.description: Lock the front peg with the deck angled over the far side of the rail.

tricks.name: Smith Grind
tricks.description: Lock the back peg with the front peg tucked behind the far side of the obstacle.

tricks.name: Drop In
tricks.description: Stomp the front wheel over the coping and ride straight down the ramp with commitment.

tricks.name: Kickturn
tricks.description: Lift the front wheel and pivot on the back wheel to turn around in the transition.

tricks.name: Rock to Fakie
tricks.description: Roll up the wall, rock the deck over the coping, and roll back in fakie.

tricks.name: Tailwhip
tricks.description: Kick the deck into a full 360 spin and stomp it back down under the feet.
Rotate a full 360 mid-air and land rolling in the same direction.

tricks.name: Fakie Tailwhip
tricks.description: Tailwhip while riding fakie and land the deck catch rolling forward.

tricks.name: Half Cab
tricks.description: Fakie 180 backside into your natural stance and keep rolling without stopping.

tricks.name: 180 Tailwhip
tricks.description: Rotate a half turn while whipping the deck and land the catch at 180.

tricks.name: Frontside 180
tricks.description: Spin a half turn frontside and land looking over the shoulder.

tricks.name: Backside 180
tricks.description: Spin a half turn backside and ride away with the rotation tucked.

tricks.name: Nollie
tricks.description: Pop off the front wheel and lift the deck into the air with the bars pulled tight.

tricks.name: Five-Oh Grind
tricks.description: Lock the back peg on the edge and hold the front wheel up through the grind.

tricks.name: Nosegrind
tricks.description: Lock the front peg on the obstacle and lift the back wheel to hold the line.

tricks.name: Crooked Grind
tricks.description: Lock the front peg and cross the deck over the obstacle at an angle for the full line.

tricks.name: Lipslide
tricks.description: Approach backside and slide the tail-side edge of the deck across the obstacle.

tricks.name: Suski Grind
tricks.description: Lock the front peg with the deck held over the rail and ride it clean to the exit.

tricks.name: Overcrook
tricks.description: Lock the front peg over the obstacle with the deck crossed through the rail line.

tricks.name: Air Out
tricks.description: Launch above the coping and carve back in without touching down.

tricks.name: Tabletop
tricks.description: Lay the deck flat and level in the air, then pull it back under the feet for the landing.

tricks.name: Tuck No Hander
tricks.description: Release both hands from the bars and tuck them tight until the landing.

tricks.name: Stalefish Grab
tricks.description: Reach behind the back leg and grab the tail of the deck mid-air.

tricks.name: Melon Grab
tricks.description: Grab the front of the deck and hold the air controlled from launch to landing.

tricks.name: Indy Grab
tricks.description: Reach down and grab the middle of the deck between the feet while airborne.

tricks.name: Mute Grab
tricks.description: Reach across the bars and grab the front edge of the deck mid-air.

tricks.name: Japan Air
tricks.description: Grab the front of the deck and lift it high over the back in the japan position.

tricks.name: 180 Air
tricks.description: Spin a half turn above the coping and land back in the ramp rolling.

tricks.name: Invert
tricks.description: Plant a hand on the coping and hold the deck inverted above the wall before dropping in.

tricks.name: Disaster
tricks.description: Hop into a double-peg stall on the coping and pivot back in without touching down.

tricks.name: Rock n Roll
tricks.description: Rock over the coping and turn back in frontside instead of rolling to fakie.

tricks.name: Fakie Disaster
tricks.description: Hit the coping in fakie, stall both pegs, and pivot back into the ramp.

tricks.name: Alley Oop
tricks.description: Spin backside against your momentum above the coping and carve back in.

tricks.name: Double Tailwhip
tricks.description: Whip the deck twice around before stomping the catch on the landing.

tricks.name: 360 Tailwhip
tricks.description: Rotate a full 360 while the deck completes a full whip in the same jump.

tricks.name: Barspin Tailwhip
tricks.description: Spin the bars and whip the deck in the same jump, catching both before the landing.

tricks.name: Double Barspin
tricks.description: Spin the bars twice around and catch them square at the top of the arc.
Rotate one and a half turns off the launch and absorb the landing clean.
Rotate two full spins above the lip and land clean in the ramp.

tricks.name: Full Cab
tricks.description: Fakie 360 backside and land rolling forward in your natural stance.

tricks.name: 360 Barspin
tricks.description: Spin a full 360 while barspinning and catch the bars mid-rotation.

tricks.name: 360 No Hander
tricks.description: Complete a 360 rotation with both hands off the bars the entire time.

tricks.name: Truck Driver
tricks.description: Spin the bars while rotating the body a full 360, catching both on the way down.

tricks.name: Frontside 360
tricks.description: Rotate a full 360 frontside and roll away looking back over the shoulder.

tricks.name: Backside 360
tricks.description: Rotate a full 360 backside and land rolling with the rotation tucked.

tricks.name: Backflip
tricks.description: Rotate fully backward with a controlled takeoff and a clean, stable landing.

tricks.name: Frontflip
tricks.description: Flip forward off the launch and land back on the transition in control.

tricks.name: Flair
tricks.description: Combine a backflip with a 180 rotation and stomp the landing facing forward.

tricks.name: McTwist
tricks.description: Launch a 540 with a late-flip twist and stomp the landing on the transition.

tricks.name: Superman
tricks.description: Extend the body off the deck in a superman stretch and pull it back in before landing.

tricks.name: Superman Seat Grab
tricks.description: Grab the seat in the superman position and hold the full extension through the air.

tricks.name: Can Can
tricks.description: Swing one leg over the bars mid-air and bring it back before the landing.

tricks.name: 360 Air
tricks.description: Rotate a full 360 above the coping and land back in the ramp clean.

tricks.name: 540 Air
tricks.description: Rotate one and a half turns above the lip and stomp the landing on the transition.

tricks.name: Alley Oop 360
tricks.description: Spin a full 360 backside against the momentum and carve back in over the coping.

tricks.name: Icepick Grind
tricks.description: Lock one peg on the rail with the deck over the obstacle and ride the icepick to the end.

tricks.name: Primo Grind
tricks.description: Flip the deck vertical and grind on its side down the full obstacle.

tricks.name: 50-50 Barspin
tricks.description: Lock the 50-50 and spin the bars mid-grind without breaking the slide.
